title: Weekly garden care for a Gordon Head family home

seo.title: Sample project: Gordon Head garden care | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: regular lawn and bed care for a Gordon Head home in Saanich, with a moss plan for a lawn shaded by tall firs.

summary: Regular lawn and bed care for a busy household with a large mossy lawn.
duration: Ongoing: March to November, plus winter cleanups
scope: Weekly mowing in spring, every other week in summer
challenge: The lawn under two big Douglas-firs was more moss than grass, and the owners had no time for weekends in the yard.
approach: We set a visit schedule and raised the mowing height. In fall we aerated and overseeded the sunnier parts of the lawn.
In the deepest shade we suggested a mulched bed of native groundcover instead of more lawn.
result: A lawn plan matched to the shade, and a schedule the family did not have to manage.
